title: index.json, version 1
description: Per-directory metadata. The top level and entries are for any reader; each other object is one tool's namespace. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere: readers ignore them and rewriters keep them.

link.description: A URL the title links to.

entries.description: The directory's described entries. Order is authored and is the display order.

name.description: A file or subdirectory name in this directory.

links.description: Other forms of the same thing: link text to target.

hidden.description: Described, but left out of listings.

all.description: Which entries are listed. Omitted or true: everything in the directory. false: only the entries above. A list: exactly the names matching one of these globs. Not inherited.

ignore.description: Globs for names to leave out. Inherited; an empty list clears what was inherited.

include.description: An HTML fragment for the top of the page. Inherited.

breadcrumbs.description: A linked trail of ancestors. Inherited.

layout.description: The built-in page template, by stem: grid, strip, sequence, background. Not inherited.

thumbnails.description: Show thumb_dir/thumb_prefix + name where that file exists.

audio.description: An audio player; false turns an inherited one off. Inherited.

transformer.description: Glob to renderer name or Content-Type. Key order is match order. Inherited and merged; an empty object clears.
